ROUTE_IDENTITY.basis: current route, fixture and packet-set manifest
ROUTE_IDENTITY.finding: Current arrest MO-610.140 route remains bound to mo-610-140-arrest-set and Jackson County filing facts.

SOURCE_IDENTITY.basis: raw current source bytes rehashed against current family receipt
SOURCE_IDENTITY.finding: CR360, CR370, FI-05 and GN10 exact source identities and byte lengths match their receipts.

COMPONENT_SET.basis: current packet-set manifest and rendered component coverage
COMPONENT_SET.finding: Current canonical and boundary assemblies contain all required route components; the arrest continuation or conviction overflow continuation is present where required, and GN10 is included only in the waiver boundary fixture.

KNOWN_PREFILLS.basis: current component text/readback plus saved-byte proof
KNOWN_PREFILLS.finding: Known neutral participant, agency, filer, OCN and waiver facts are present in current fixtures; no known fact is silently dropped.

REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING.basis: current guides, continuation and exact source-labeled writes
REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING.finding: Current guide and packet preserve required Case.net/record, filing, agency, timing, continuation, waiver and participant handbacks for this route.

ROUTE_OPTIONS.basis: current import validation, fixture branch and focused negative controls
ROUTE_OPTIONS.finding: Current route and waiver/proposed-order branches are explicit; judicial determinations and protected choices remain blank or handback.

REPEATING_ROWS.basis: current CR360/CR370/continuation mapping and OCN audit
REPEATING_ROWS.finding: All supported agencies and conviction OCNs are retained, with overflow carried to the continuation and no silent row truncation.

PROTECTED_FIELDS.basis: current field map/refusal report and focused protected-input controls
PROTECTED_FIELDS.finding: Court assignments, findings, case/file stamps, judge fields and participant signatures/dates remain protected or later-completion fields.

ARTIFACTS.finding: Both current packet PDFs match the frozen current manifest exactly.

PAGE_ORDER.finding: Current packet components appear in declared order and every current canonical/boundary page is covered.

CLIPPING_AND_OVERLAP.basis: Direct independent viewing of every original PNG page in the per-family custody archive, after exact SHA-256, byte-length and PNG-dimension comparison to the immutable PAGE_IMAGES_SHA256 inventory.
CLIPPING_AND_OVERLAP.finding: All 13 canonical and 14 boundary original pages were directly viewed. Prepared values fit their source regions; no clipping, overlap, missing ink, blank page or unauthorized protected-field ink was observed.

FILING_DESTINATION.basis: current guide plus filing-county negative controls
FILING_DESTINATION.finding: Current guidance binds the filing county and preserves clerk/counsel handoffs without inventing a different county.

FEE_AND_WAIVER.basis: current GN10 branch, waiver inputs and guide
FEE_AND_WAIVER.finding: GN10 is conditional on participant waiver facts, including spouse data when married; no fee, waiver or judicial result is inferred.

SERVICE.basis: current agency respondent mapping and participant guidance
SERVICE.finding: Agency defendants, prosecutor/statutory notice and contested-hearing handoffs remain explicit; no completed service act is fabricated.

SELF_HELP_STOP.basis: current negative controls, route handbacks and guide stop language
SELF_HELP_STOP.finding: Current route-specific eligibility, timing, county, multi-county, agency, collateral-rights, prior-relief and legal handbacks are explicit.
